el.Tras una elección nacional descorazonado: After a heartbreaking national election, an actress without a stage leaves her daughters a note on the fridge: “wake me when this term is over.” Three women of the same lineage retreat from a world they can no longer recognize, amid paranoia, desire and bewilderment.

Training the stage, in the present tense.
el.Trabajamos el cuerpo, la improvisación,: We work on the body, improvisation, listening, our relationship with space, and approaching text. For performing artists, students, performers, theater lovers, and anyone who wants to begin.
el.Teatro y creación escénica. Lunes de 20: Theater and stage creation. Mondays from 8 to 10:30 pm in Palermo. With Roxana Berco and María Valiente. Try a free class, no strings attached.
el.Investigación escénica a partir de Greta: Stage research inspired by Greta Gerwig, Joachim Trier and Federico Fellini. Saturdays from 2 to 4:30 pm at Teatro Patio de Actores. Audiovisual material is provided to every participant.
el.Encuentros intensivos para profundizar e: Intensive sessions to delve deeper into stage presence, the monologue as an open structure, the language of gestures, and the biographical as a secret archive.
el.«La escena en teatro sucede en presente,: “A scene in theater happens in the present, because theater is the present tense. And what is central in my present is the other.”
el.Cada año los grupos estrenan una creació: Every year, the groups premiere an original creation at Teatro Patio de Actores.
